lina - AE: Quick thread: client ArborLabs wants a 7-day Private POC across two AWS accounts + onprem. They asked which is easier to stand up: cross-account interface endpoints (PrivateLink) or VPC peering + shared services? Also asked for a one-line POC network cost estimate and a short pasteable firewall rule.

omar - solutions eng: PrivateLink wins for cross-account isolation and least routing changes. Peering works if CIDRs don't overlap and you want direct routing, but it scales poorly for many spokes. For a quick POC PrivateLink = faster.

sanjay - netops: Ops caveats: PrivateLink needs an ENI in each AZ in the consumer VPCs. Ensure endpoint policies allow the cross-account principals. If they SNAT at the edge we will see ENI IPs not client IPs 7 for src-ip preservation either avoid SNAT on path to ENI or use 1:1 NAT. For peering ensure route tables updated and check MTU if they have onprem tunnels.

claire - security: Security notes: we support customer-managed KMS for Private. TLS1.3 default; mutual-TLS available. If customer performs TLS inspection and terminates TLS, mutual-TLS/client certs cannot traverse  recommend bypass rules for our endpoint CIDRs for auth/streaming. We'll draft the security questionnaire snippets.

lina - AE: POC network estimate (7 days, ~5TB egress)?

omar - solutions eng: Ballpark: PrivateLink endpoints ~ $0.01-0.02/hr per endpoint + data processing ~$0.01/GB. For 5TB (~5000GB) data processing ~ $50; 2 AZ endpoints for 7 days =~ $7-8 -> ~ $58. Mention this is network-only; GPU/dedicated capacity separate.

sanjay - netops: Pasteable firewall snippet (replace CIDRs with exact list we'll upload):
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.120.30.0/28","10.120.31.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# To preserve client IP: ensure no SNAT between app subnet and ENI route or use 1:1 NAT

claire - security: Action: I'll put SOC2/KMS/TLS bullets into the ticket. If legal asks for a diagram, ping me.

sanjay - netops: Action: I'll attach exact ENI CIDRs and a short SNAT bypass iptables example to the ticket AB-POC-303 by 1700 PT.

lina - AE: Great  I'll update the customer after artifacts are in the ticket. :thumbsup:
